q: What changes in our second year of GHG verification?
title: Your second GHG verification
short: The verifier checks that last year's findings were closed, compares this year with the base year, and looks hard at anything that changed: new sites, new factors, new methods. Explain each change in a short note before they ask, and keep last year's working papers handy.

ul: Corrective actions from last year's findings.
Year-on-year changes above your materiality threshold.
Updated factors, such as a new CEA grid version.

p: A one-page change log listing sites, sources, factors and methods that changed, with the reason, saves days of questions.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements (iso.org)
